QuestionLedger

Question ledger for one shared security pool, question and universe. Shares and reporting are question-specific; provider capital, settlement cash and fees are accounted centrally. QuestionLedger source contract

Read surface

Read security pool owner positions from the capital ledger and question fee streams from the settlement book. Amounts named AttoEth use raw units of the security pool collateral token; no token metadata is required. After security pool binding, question storage mirrors settlement cash, share supply and lastSettlementSecurityPoolTime, the security pool time of its last checkpoint. Fee stream deadlines use native time; question storage does not enumerate owners. getCurrentMintingCapacityAttoEth is zero once the question ends or reporting starts; otherwise it includes current question collateral and available shared capacity. attoSharesToAttoEth, attoSharesToAttoRep and attoEthToAttoShares quote central settlement including fork recovery rights. isEscalationResolved recognizes inherited final outcomes and locally finalized reports. The settlement book tracks each question’s fee stream. An unreported question can continue paying fees after its calendar end until reporting starts. Additional validated configuration and accounting getters: questionId, universeId, initialEscalationGameDepositAttoRep, zoltar, parent, shareToken, repToken, openOraclePriceCoordinator, openOracle, escalationGameFactory, accountingModule, escalationGame, questionData, questionForker, securityPoolFactory, settlementCollateralAttoEth, statoblastSecurityMultiplierBps, shareTokenSupplyAttoShares, lastSettlementSecurityPoolTime, awaitingForkContinuation, systemState, securityPoolCustody.

Security assumptions

Price-sensitive withdrawal, commitment-increase, and liquidation calls depend on A16 timely inclusion, A21 REP and selected collateral behavior, A19 observable correctable price, and A06 lifecycle executors. User-initiated question ledger calls additionally depend on A28 account authority.

State-changing interactions

Each call lists its parameter names in ABI order. The contract index defines the columns. All deployed question ledgers belong to a security pool. Providers use its capital ledger for deposits, commitments, health targets, retirement and liquidation. Reporters fund separate reporter custody with wallet REP. Purchases use the registered security pool route; traders redeem through the question ledger. There is no standalone vault, tick auction or operation queue.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
setSecurityPoolCustody(custody) The canonical security pool Nonzero custody; not already bound; caller matches factory registration. Binds its central capital ledger once and registers the question fee stream. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
creditEscalationSurplus(amountAttoRep) The active escalation game Caller matches the configured game; REP has already been transferred. Transfers irrevocable surplus REP to the security pool for vested provider earnings. Reporter principal remains separate. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
refreshSecurityPoolFees() Anyone Central accounting is bound. Refreshes the question linear stream and settlement mirrors. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
burnEscalationWinnerHaircut(amountAttoRep) The active escalation game Caller matches the configured game; REP has already been transferred. Burns the winning settlement haircut through Zoltar. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
createCompleteSet(cash) The registered security pool purchase route Operational unforked universe, reporting not started, question not ended, authenticated purchase and sufficient healthy backing. Mints question complete sets using central settlement cash and shared backing. The security pool transfers the resulting shares to the buyer. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
redeemCompleteSet(amountAttoShares) A complete-set holder Operational unforked universe; holder has all outcome shares. Burns complete sets and pays their current collateral and recovery REP entitlement. Released exposure becomes available to the security pool. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
redeemShares() A winning-share holder Operational question with a final outcome; finalized claims retain their protected settlement path. Burns winning shares and pays their central collateral and recovery REP entitlement. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
depositWalletRepToEscalationGame(outcome, maximumDepositAttoRep) Any reporter Valid outcome, wallet allowance and balance, operational reporting window; no inherited fixed outcome. Transfers accepted wallet REP into separate reporter custody and records the chosen outcome; starts the game if needed, deploying it unless EscalationGameFactory.prepareEscalationGame already did. EscalationGameSet when the game is created, followed by reporter deposit and REP transfer events.
depositWalletRepToEscalationGameWithLead(outcome, maximumDepositAttoRep) Any reporter Ordinary wallet reporting prerequisites; the resulting outcome balance exceeds every other balance or fills its threshold (Deposit does not lead). An opposing top-up that invalidates this condition causes the whole transaction to revert. Performs the ordinary wallet deposit only if it leaves the chosen outcome strictly leading, or fills its non-decision threshold. The reporting UI uses this protected form when the caller requests a leading result. The ordinary wallet deposit signals; none survive a failed lead condition.
withdrawFromEscalationGame(outcome, depositIndexes) Anyone, for one recorded depositor Operational question and final outcome; unresolved parent claims follow the child settlement path. Settles the supplied local deposit indexes. Payout goes to the recorded owner; losing claims receive no REP. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
withdrawForkedEscalationDeposits(outcome, proofs) Anyone, for one recorded depositor Operational finalized question, valid unconsumed proofs, one depositor per batch. Settles authenticated inherited leaves without migrating every reporter. Payouts go to the recorded owner. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
updateSettlementCollateral() Anyone Central accounting is bound. Checkpoints central question fees and updates the local settlement mirror. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
setStartingParams() The factory Factory authentication; deployment initialization. Initializes the question fee clock. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
activateForkMode() QuestionForker only No inherited fixed outcome; the central fork checks apply. Freezes shared security pool accounting and marks the question forked. SystemStateSet on the transition to forked, and none for a repeated call; relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
initializeForkedEscalationGame(startBondAttoRep, nonDecisionThresholdAttoRep, elapsedAtFork, fixedQuestionOutcome) QuestionForker only No existing game. Deploys a continuation game with the inherited bond, threshold, elapsed time and outcome. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
initializeForkCarryOutcome(sourceGame, snapshotId, peaks, leafCount, carryTotalAttoRep, resolutionBalanceAttoRep, nullifierRoot) QuestionForker only A game is configured; it is a fork continuation with fewer than three initialized outcomes; leaf counts fit the MMR; every call supplies the same source and nonzero snapshot ID, with the next outcome’s data; the third call verifies the full commitment. Installs the next outcome of the continuation game’s canonical snapshot. Three calls install immutable inherited roots and leaf counts, plus mutable current peaks, carry totals, resolution balances, and normalized nullifier roots. ForkCarryCheckpoint on completion of the third outcome
resumeForkedEscalationGame() Anyone Complete authenticated carry snapshot and funded central reporter custody. Resumes a prepared continuation from the shared child branch activation timestamp. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
setAwaitingForkContinuation(shouldAwait) QuestionForker only No lifecycle or value-change guard. Stores whether complete-set minting must wait for continuation initialization, then refreshes bound security pool fee accounting. AwaitingForkContinuationSet, including for a repeated value; bound question ledgers then emit central checkpoints and stream replacement when applicable
setSystemState(newState) QuestionForker only No transition or value-change guard. Replaces the question ledger lifecycle state directly, then refreshes bound security pool fee accounting. SystemStateSet, including for a repeated state; bound question ledgers then emit central checkpoints and stream replacement when applicable
setShareTokenSupplyAttoShares(newShareTokenSupplyAttoShares) QuestionForker only Caller is the immutable forker. Initializes the child question share-supply mirror. Relevant share, reporting or central accounting events; no standalone vault accounting.
authorizeChildQuestionLedger(pool) QuestionForker only This parent question ledger is already authorized; candidate reports this share token; candidate universe has no different canonical question ledger. No question ledger lifecycle guard. Asks the lineage share token to establish pool as the canonical authorized question ledger for its universe; reauthorizing the same question ledger is a no-op. AuthorizationUpdated only on first authorization; no event when already authorized
